policies.name: current_confirmation
policies.purpose: Replay the recorded normal PROTECT target eligibility and BTC leadership confirmation under the same small-position execution model as the alternatives.

policies.name: uncentered_alpha_control
policies.purpose: Diagnostic control: use positive tanh of the uncentered Alpha6 factor score for direction, rank eligible symbols by relative score, preserve f4/f5 and two-round confirmation.

policies.name: direction_then_rank
policies.purpose: Require absolute positive price direction and market breadth; use the recorded Alpha6 relative score only to rank eligible symbols.

policies.name: direction_rank_simple
policies.purpose: Simplification ablation: positive price direction plus cost-aware momentum; Alpha6 relative score only ranks eligible symbols. Remove independent Alpha6 score/side, f4, f5, breadth and two-round vetoes for this offline variant.

shared_execution.gate_cost: max(recorded selected entry gate cost, scenario roundtrip cost)
shared_execution.fill_cost: scenario roundtrip cost split equally between entry and exit; actual realized execution costs are not known for hypothetical orders
shared_execution.execution_delay: Entry at the next completed 1H close after the decision window. Existing stop/target orders are modeled intrabar; time exits use the observed hour close.
shared_execution.intrabar_stop_rule: Test the stop before take-profit using hourly high/low; same-bar ambiguity is resolved against the strategy; gaps fill at the worse available opening price.
shared_execution.history_gap_rule: Missing observations cannot confirm consecutive signals; no entry without complete causal bars and a current recorded quote.

recovery_audit.candidate_design: Keep PROTECT active while evaluating a separately bounded research trial. No automatic promotion from historical replay results.

amendment_reason: User explicitly requested fewer redundant restrictions and more active participation before any replay performance results were computed.
